claim_scope: train-only 256-record group-disjoint phase-carrier generalization experiment; not validation/test promotion
hypothesis: The deployment-legal eikonal phase carrier that improved one-record capacity will strictly reduce two-seed mean confirmation error on four-family unseen train groups versus an otherwise identical raw WFP.
single_conceptual_change: source-dependent eikonal phase carrier enabled versus disabled

travel.physical: radius-4 grid eikonal on sigma-2 201x201 background velocity
travel.exterior: same grid eikonal on 221x241 edge-extended velocity with 20 CPML layers on left/right/bottom
travel.source: nearest grid node plus positive fractional source-offset time

shared_training.batch: one record-frequency pair per family, batch size 4
shared_training.coverage: every fit record and all 64 frequencies exactly once per epoch
shared_training.physical_loss: frequency-count-scaled coefficient SSE divided by the complete record coefficient energy
shared_training.confirmation: 32 disjoint records opened once for selected checkpoint

primary_metric: two-seed mean confirmation physical 64-bin relative L2
failure_signal: Reject E1d and do not generate 2800 derived labels if phase mean does not strictly improve, any boundary/split contract fails, or outputs are non-finite.
conditional_next_step: Only an accepted E1d may trigger derived-label generation and final retraining on all 2800 train records.
rollback: Additive run. Preserve all prior checkpoints and the 256-record cache. Keep best/latest only in each E1d lane.
